title.ko: 가정법과 격식체: lest · were it to · suffice it to say · insist that + 동사원형
title.en: subjunctive and formal registers: lest, were it to, suffice it to say, insist that + base form

explain.ko: 제안, 요구, 필요를 나타내는 동사(propose, insist, demand, recommend)와 형용사(imperative, essential, advisable) 뒤의 that절에서는 동사원형을 씁니다. 이것이 가정법 현재입니다. lest는 '~하지 않도록'이라는 뜻의 격식 접속사로 should 또는 동사원형을 이끌고, Were he to / Should it / Had we 같은 도치로 격식 있는 조건문을 만듭니다. Suffice it to say는 상세한 설명을 생략할 때 쓰는 고정 표현입니다.
explain.en: After verbs of proposing, insisting, demanding and recommending (propose, insist, demand, recommend) and adjectives such as imperative, essential and advisable, that-clauses use the base form: the present subjunctive. Lest is a formal conjunction meaning 'for fear that', taking should or the base form, and inversions such as Were he to, Should it and Had we make formal conditionals. Suffice it to say is a fixed phrase for skipping detailed explanation.

trans.ko:
A: 위원회는 어떻게 하라고 요구했나요?

lines.t: Formal English uses the base form in that-clauses after verbs of proposing, demanding and necessity. This is the present subjunctive. After lest, either should or the base form follows. Such structures are common in legal, official and academic writing.

trans.ko: 격식 있는 영어는 제안, 요구, 필요를 나타내는 동사 뒤에서 that절에 동사원형을 씁니다. 이것을 가정법 현재라고 합니다. 또한 lest 뒤에는 should가 있거나 동사원형이 옵니다. 이런 구문은 법률, 공문, 학술 글에서 흔합니다.

task.model: All staff must follow the rules, lest this accident recur. Suffice it to say the investigation results fell short of expectations. The committee insists that a safety inspection be carried out immediately. Should it rain, the event will be moved indoors.

model_trans.ko: 이번 사고가 반복되지 않도록 모든 직원은 규정을 지켜야 합니다. 조사 결과가 기대에 못 미쳤다고만 말씀드리겠습니다. 위원회는 안전 점검을 즉시 시행할 것을 요구합니다. 비가 온다면 행사는 실내로 옮겨질 것입니다.
model_trans.en: All staff must follow the rules, lest this accident recur. Suffice it to say the investigation results fell short of expectations. The committee insists that a safety inspection be carried out immediately. Should it rain, the event will be moved indoors.
